365-Calorie Smoky Chipotle Chicken Burritos

Quick Lunches Ep. 3 — two burritos: Kirkland chipotle chicken, Smoky Chipotle Crema, Mezete pickled red onions, on Mission Carb Balance tortillas. ~365 cal / 49g protein (est.) for both.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME4 min prep + 10 min reheat
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~365 cal | ~49g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: REHEAT CHICKEN PER THE PACKAGE, TO 165 F. Do not invent a temperature — appliance settings vary. Use your air fryer's default reheat preset for about 10 min.

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 2 Mission Carb Balance tortillas (~70 cal each)
  • 6 oz Kirkland / Costco shortcut chipotle chicken (fully cooked)
  • 1/2 serving Smoky Chipotle Crema (~1 1/2 tbsp; cross-link to /cookbook/smoky-chipotle-crema)
  • Mezete pickled red onions, to taste

Allergens: dairy, wheat, gluten. Packaged labels vary — verify current Mission Carb Balance, Kirkland chipotle chicken, and Mezete pickled onion packages before publishing allergen or gluten free tags. The cross linked Smoky Chipotle Crema contains milk and egg from mayonnaise. No air fryer temperature published — appliance settings vary. Follow the physical Kirkland chipotle chicken package for definitive heating guidance.

You want a hot chipotle-chicken burrito lunch in about 14 min flat and you already have a batch of Smoky Chipotle Crema in the fridge. Two burritos land at ~365 cal / 49g protein estimated. Third episode of the Quick Lunches numbered series.

Method

  1. 1.REHEAT CHICKEN. Air-fry 6 oz Kirkland chipotle chicken about 10 minutes per the package guidance, until hot and 165 F. Appliance settings vary — no temperature invented; use your air fryer's default reheat preset.
  2. 2.SAUCE TORTILLAS. Lay out both Mission Carb Balance tortillas. Divide the Smoky Chipotle Crema evenly between them, spreading in the center — leave the tortilla edges dry so they seal cleanly when rolled.
  3. 3.ADD CRUNCH. Scatter Mezete pickled red onions to taste over the crema. The onions go under the chicken so they don't wilt from the hot chicken making contact directly.
  4. 4.FILL WITH CHICKEN. Divide the hot chipotle chicken evenly between both tortillas. Keep the fill line in the center third — over-fill and the tortilla will split at the roll.
  5. 5.ROLL + EAT. Fold in the sides of each tortilla, roll tightly toward the far edge, and eat immediately while the chicken is hot and the tortilla is soft.

Keys to success

  • BUILD ORDER: CREMA → ONIONS → CHICKEN. Crema goes on the dry tortilla so it doesn't soak through. Onions on top of the crema so the crema sticks them in place. Chicken last so the heat doesn't wilt the onion.
  • LEAVE THE TORTILLA EDGES DRY. Crema stays in the center third — sauce on the edges means the roll won't seal.

If something fails

Tortilla split at the roll: Over-filled or edges got wet with crema. Keep the fill line in the center third and leave a 1-inch dry border on all sides.

Onions wilted flat: Chicken was placed directly on the onions with no crema layer between them. Fix by rebuilding: crema → onions → chicken.

Burrito tastes cold in the middle: Chicken wasn't fully reheated. Confirm 165 F center with an instant-read; if the package reheat time isn't hitting 165, add 1-2 min.

Crema soaked through the tortilla: Too much crema or spread too thin. 1 1/2 tbsp total split between two tortillas is the tested portion — keep it in the center.

Not filling enough for lunch: Add a broth cup on the side, or bump to 7 oz chicken (~+35 cal / +7g protein). The two-burrito serving is intentionally an adult single lunch, not a snack.

Storage and reheating

Store: Best assembled and eaten immediately. If prepping components, keep tortillas, chicken, crema, and onions separate.

Reheat: N/A — assemble hot. Follow the Kirkland chipotle chicken package for reheat guidance if pulling from a stored batch.

Lasts: Assembled = same-meal only. Components hold per each package's own storage guidance.

Flavor target

Hot Kirkland chipotle chicken (the real shortcut) + Smoky Chipotle Crema on the tortilla + Mezete pickled red onions for acid and crunch. The build order matters — crema first, onions second, chicken last — so the chicken heat doesn't wilt the onion and the crema doesn't soak through the tortilla.

Brands I use

Costco / Kirkland
Chipotle Seasoned Grilled Chicken (~100 cal / 16g protein per 3 oz)
The featured shortcut. Fully cooked, seriously flavorful, ready in ~10 min from fridge to hot. 6 oz across both burritos is the protein anchor. Not sponsored — creator-purchased.
Mission
Carb Balance Flour Tortillas, Fajita Size (~70 cal / 4g protein per tortilla)
Two tortillas at ~140 cal / 8g protein is what makes 49g total feasible without adding a second protein. Flexible, holds a tight roll.
The Split Plate
Smoky Chipotle Crema (cookbook cross-link)
The heat + creamy identity. 1/2 serving (~1 1/2 tbsp) split across both tortillas is enough. Batch once (12 servings, 5-7 day fridge life) and it also drops into wings, tacos, bowls, steak — ecosystem sauce.
Mezete
Pickled Red Onions
The acid + crunch. Any pickled red onion works; Mezete is what's filmed.
